# Stanford University
> Stanford University is a leading research university offering academic programs, research initiatives, libraries, news, and public resources across many disciplines.

Stanford’s web presence spans university-wide admissions and academics, schools and departments, research centers, libraries, healthcare, athletics, and public-facing news and events. This guide highlights authoritative entry points and high-value resources across the stanford.edu domain.

## University Overview
- [Stanford University Home](https://www.stanford.edu/): Main university homepage with access to academics, research, campus life, and institutional resources.
- [About Stanford](https://www.stanford.edu/about/): Overview of Stanford’s mission, history, leadership, and institutional profile.
- [Academics](https://www.stanford.edu/academics/): Central hub for undergraduate, graduate, and continuing education academic information.
- [Research](https://www.stanford.edu/research/): University-wide overview of Stanford research programs, initiatives, and impact.
- [Campus Life](https://www.stanford.edu/campus-life/): Information about student life, housing, dining, wellness, and campus communities.
- [Admission](https://www.stanford.edu/admission/): Entry point to undergraduate, graduate, and financial aid admissions resources.
- [Facts](https://facts.stanford.edu/): Official institutional facts, figures, rankings, enrollment, and university statistics.

## Admissions and Financial Aid
- [Undergraduate Admission](https://admission.stanford.edu/): Official undergraduate admissions site with application requirements, deadlines, and student information.
- [Graduate Admissions](https://gradadmissions.stanford.edu/): Central resource for graduate application processes and program admissions guidance.
- [Financial Aid Office](https://financialaid.stanford.edu/): Undergraduate financial aid policies, application steps, and cost information.
- [Student Services Center](https://studentservices.stanford.edu/): Administrative support for enrollment, billing, records, and student account services.
- [Registrar’s Office](https://registrar.stanford.edu/): Academic calendar, enrollment, transcripts, degree progress, and registration policies.
- [VPUE](https://vpue.stanford.edu/): Undergraduate education resources, advising, and academic support programs.

## Academics and Schools
- [Schools of Stanford](https://www.stanford.edu/academics/): Overview of Stanford’s schools, programs, and educational offerings.
- [School of Engineering](https://engineering.stanford.edu/): Engineering school programs, departments, research, and student resources.
- [School of Humanities and Sciences](https://humsci.stanford.edu/): Programs and departments across arts, humanities, social sciences, and natural sciences.
- [School of Medicine](https://med.stanford.edu/): Medical education, biomedical research, departments, and clinical innovation.
- [Stanford Law School](https://law.stanford.edu/): Legal education, research centers, clinics, and academic programs.
- [Graduate School of Business](https://www.gsb.stanford.edu/): MBA, MSx, PhD, executive education, and business research resources.
- [Graduate School of Education](https://ed.stanford.edu/): Education research, degree programs, policy work, and teaching initiatives.
- [Doerr School of Sustainability](https://sustainability.stanford.edu/): Sustainability-focused education, research, and interdisciplinary initiatives.

## Research and Labs
- [Office of the Vice Provost and Dean of Research](https://doresearch.stanford.edu/): Research administration, compliance, funding, and policy resources for Stanford investigators.
- [Stanford Research](https://www.stanford.edu/research/): University-level overview of major research themes and interdisciplinary work.
- [SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory](https://www.slac.stanford.edu/): National laboratory for photon science, accelerator research, and fundamental physics.
- [Stanford Institute for Human-Centered AI](https://hai.stanford.edu/): Research, policy, and education focused on human-centered artificial intelligence.
- [Wu Tsai Neurosciences Institute](https://neuroscience.stanford.edu/): Interdisciplinary neuroscience research, training, and community programs.
- [Bio-X](https://biox.stanford.edu/): Interdisciplinary biosciences initiative connecting medicine, engineering, and basic science.
- [Precourt Institute for Energy](https://energy.stanford.edu/): Energy research, policy, and innovation programs across Stanford.
- [Woods Institute for the Environment](https://woods.stanford.edu/): Environmental research, policy engagement, and sustainability initiatives.

## Libraries and Scholarly Resources
- [Stanford Libraries](https://library.stanford.edu/): Library services, collections, research support, and digital scholarship resources.
- [SearchWorks](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/): Stanford Libraries catalog for books, journals, archives, and digital materials.
- [Digital Repository](https://purl.stanford.edu/): Persistent links to Stanford digital objects and repository materials.
- [Stanford University Press](https://www.sup.org/): Academic publishing in humanities, social sciences, and related scholarly fields.
- [HighWire Press](https://www.highwirepress.com/): Scholarly publishing technology and journal platform originating from Stanford.
- [Lane Medical Library](https://lane.stanford.edu/): Medical and health sciences library resources for research and clinical education.

## Computing and Technical Resources
- [Stanford University IT](https://uit.stanford.edu/): Central IT services, accounts, networking, security, and technical support.
- [Stanford Profiles](https://profiles.stanford.edu/): Faculty and researcher directory with publications, affiliations, and expertise.
- [ExploreCourses](https://explorecourses.stanford.edu/): Course catalog with current and historical Stanford class offerings.
- [Axess](https://axess.stanford.edu/): Student and employee portal for academic and administrative transactions.
- [SUNet ID](https://uit.stanford.edu/service/sunetid): Account identity information and SUNet ID service guidance.
- [Cardinal Key](https://uit.stanford.edu/service/cardinalkey): Two-step authentication and account security service documentation.
- [Stanford Web Services](https://uit.stanford.edu/service/web): Web hosting, content management, and web technology support.

## News, Events, and Public Communication
- [Stanford News](https://news.stanford.edu/): Official university news covering research, campus developments, and expert perspectives.
- [Events Calendar](https://events.stanford.edu/): Public calendar of lectures, conferences, performances, and campus events.
- [Stanford Report](https://news.stanford.edu/report/): University announcements and internal news for the Stanford community.
- [Stanford Magazine](https://stanfordmag.org/): Alumni magazine featuring university stories, ideas, and profiles.
- [Office of University Communications](https://ucomm.stanford.edu/): Media relations, communications resources, and institutional messaging support.
- [Stanford on Social Media](https://www.stanford.edu/social-media/): Directory of official Stanford social media channels and guidance.

## Health and Medicine
- [Stanford Medicine](https://med.stanford.edu/): Umbrella site for Stanford’s medical school, research, and healthcare initiatives.
- [Stanford Health Care](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/): Adult patient care, specialties, appointments, and hospital services.
- [Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/): Pediatric and maternal healthcare services, specialties, and patient resources.
- [School of Medicine Research](https://med.stanford.edu/research.html): Biomedical and clinical research programs across Stanford Medicine.
- [Stanford Medicine News Center](https://med.stanford.edu/news.html): News and feature stories about medical research, care, and education.
- [Vaden Health Services](https://vaden.stanford.edu/): Student health, counseling, and wellness services on campus.

## Student Life and Campus Resources
- [Campus Life](https://www.stanford.edu/campus-life/): Overview of residential, social, wellness, and extracurricular student life.
- [Residential & Dining Enterprises](https://rde.stanford.edu/): Housing, dining, and residential education services for students.
- [Office of Student Affairs](https://studentaffairs.stanford.edu/): Student support, inclusion, leadership, and campus engagement resources.
- [BeWell](https://bewell.stanford.edu/): Employee and community wellness programs, events, and health resources.
- [Career Education](https://careereducation.stanford.edu/): Career advising, internships, job search support, and employer engagement.
- [HAI Student Programs](https://hai.stanford.edu/education): Educational opportunities and student engagement in AI-related fields.
- [Stanford Alumni](https://alumni.stanford.edu/): Alumni programs, events, communities, and lifelong connection resources.

## Athletics and Recreation
- [Stanford Athletics](https://gostanford.com/): Official athletics site with teams, schedules, rosters, and sports news.
- [Recreation and Wellness](https://rec.stanford.edu/): Fitness facilities, classes, intramurals, and recreational programs.
- [Stanford Ticket Office](https://gostanford.evenue.net/): Ticket purchasing for Stanford athletic events and related experiences.
- [Arrillaga Outdoor Education and Recreation Center](https://rec.stanford.edu/facilities/arrillaga-outdoor-education-and-recreation-center): Facility information for outdoor recreation and fitness activities.
- [Club Sports](https://rec.stanford.edu/sport-programs/club-sports): Student club sports programs, participation details, and team information.

## Giving, Alumni, and Outreach
- [Office of Development](https://giving.stanford.edu/): Giving opportunities, campaigns, donor information, and philanthropic priorities.
- [Stanford Alumni Association](https://alumni.stanford.edu/): Alumni benefits, events, volunteer opportunities, and regional communities.
- [Parents and Families](https://parents.stanford.edu/): Resources and updates for families supporting Stanford students.
- [Continuing Studies](https://continuingstudies.stanford.edu/): Public and lifelong learning courses offered through Stanford.
- [Hoover Institution](https://www.hoover.org/): Public policy research institution affiliated with Stanford University.
- [Cantor Arts Center](https://museum.stanford.edu/): Stanford art museum with exhibitions, collections, and public programs.
